    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a number")

        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and positive")
    return value


def canvas_pixels(width_units, height_units, density):

    height_units = _positive_number("height_units", height_units)
    density = _positive_number("density", density)
    return int(width_units * density), int(height_units * density)
```
